purpose: Run a new prospective TOTAL_CORNERS cohort while quarantining ambiguous bookmaker snapshots locally and preserving systemic fail-closed integrity. This version never reinterprets or promotes v3.1.2 evidence.

change_rationale.observed_evidence: All 15 FanDuel bookmaker-market raws in the closed v3.1.2 cohort contained duplicate outcome keys: 256 keys had different prices at the same market timestamp. Two FanDuel snapshots were already stale under the 300-second gate, leaving 219 freshness-eligible conflicting keys in the closed audit. No provider field distinguishes which price is authoritative.
change_rationale.scope: Change failure propagation only: a conflicting duplicate invalidates the entire bookmaker snapshot for that cell, but does not invalidate independent bookmaker snapshots in the same raw response.

denominator.exclusion_rule: Only rows outside the fixed competition/time window, exact duplicate rows, or rows without a parseable kickoff may be excluded; odds availability is never an exclusion reason.
denominator.small_cohort_rule: Retain and accumulate every eligible fixture; do not declare final PASS or FAIL before the minimum denominator is complete.

collection.candidate_selection_basis: Unchanged from v3.1.2. FanDuel remains observable and is not removed after observation; ambiguous FanDuel snapshots are quarantined by the generic bookmaker-local rule.
collection.provider_event_resolution: Exact normalized home, away and kickoff within 15 minutes. Unresolved events remain in the denominator and are uncovered. Fuzzy resolution is prohibited.

bookmaker_snapshot_quality.conflicting_duplicate_rule: If one bookmaker has more than one distinct decimal price for the same market key, half-point line, side and market last_update, quarantine that bookmaker's entire snapshot for the cell.
bookmaker_snapshot_quality.exact_duplicate_rule: Byte-equivalent outcome keys with the same price may be deterministically collapsed; they do not create new information.
bookmaker_snapshot_quality.cross_book_rescue_rule: Independent valid bookmakers in the same immutable raw remain independently evaluable; prices are never paired across bookmakers.
global_integrity_failure_scope: collection more than 300 seconds before prediction_as_of

promotion.final_pass_requires: A newly frozen v3.1.3 cohort, minimum denominator in every competition, all three horizon coverage gates, at least one admitted bookmaker per competition, systemic integrity PASS and a separate formal Step H review.
